2609.28064.title: SlackDrive: Reclaiming Runtime Slack for Adaptive Driving Inference
2609.28064.paper_summary: Driving world-action models improve planning by coupling multimodal reasoning with future prediction, but their growing inference cost increasingly conflicts with the real-time latency requirements of vehicle control. Existing acceleration methods reduce tokens, layers, or sampling steps with policies selected prior to deployment, yet leave residual runtime variation largely unexploited after offline profiling and static scheduling on shared onboard compute. We observe that the largest admissible compute budget varies systematically with the residual runtime state, while recent realized latency provides a direct signal of the available compute slack. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{SlackDrive}, a pre-inference compute allocator that reuses realized latency to select the compute budget of each control step before model execution. SlackDrive profiles the latency and planning utility of a small discrete budget set once, estimates online compute state from completed forwards, and selects the highest-utility budget predicted to remain within the admissible latency envelope, complementing existing profiling and resource scheduling while preserving the driving backbone and its compute actuator. On NAVSIM v2 with DriveDreamer-Policy, SlackDrive improves latency-constrained EPDMS by $21.7\%$ over the strongest baseline under a stringent latency regime, while the full-budget model and preconfigured token-pruning baselines exceed the admissible latency envelope under runtime contention.
2609.28064.paper_summary_zh: 駕駛世界行動模型透過將多模態推理與未來預測結合來改善規劃，但其不斷增長的推理成本與車輛控制的實時延遲需求之間的衝突日益加劇。現有的加速方法通過在部署之前選擇策略來減少標記、層數或採樣步驟，但在離線剖析和靜態調度共享車載計算後，仍然有大量的剩餘運行時變化未被充分利用。我們觀察到，最大可接受的計算預算與剩餘運行時狀態之間存在系統性變化，而最近實現的延遲則提供了可用計算鬆弛的直接信號。受到這一觀察的啟發，我們提出了\textbf{SlackDrive}，這是一種預推理計算分配器，通過重用實現的延遲來選擇每個控制步驟的計算預算，並在模型執行之前進行選擇。SlackDrive對一小組離散預算集進行一次延遲和規劃效用的剖析，從已完成的前向估計在線計算狀態，並選擇預測在可接受延遲範圍內的最高效用預算，這補充了現有的剖析和資源調度，同時保留了駕駛骨幹及其計算執行器。在NAVSIM v2與DriveDreamer-Policy的組合下，SlackDrive在嚴格的延遲範疇內，相比最強基準提高了$21.7\%$的延遲限制EPDMS，而全預算模型和預配置的標記修剪基準在運行時競爭下超過了可接受的延遲範圍。
